raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers.region has trailing whitespace on 25 rows ('EAST ', 'WEST ', 'SOUTH ', 'NORTH '). silver_customers only applies upper(), so these rows become extra region values and gold_region_daily splits each region's totals across two groups.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT customer_id, upper(trim(region)) AS region FROM raw_customers", "gold_region_daily": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold_region_daily AS SELECT t.txn_date, c.region, count(*) AS n_txn, sum(t.amount) AS total FROM silver_transactions t JOIN silver_customers c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY t.txn_date, c.region"}}
